title: Seed Broker
blurb: Market trader: wheat shirt, sage waistcoat with flap pockets and brass buttons, leather belt and buckle, cross-body satchel, rolled trouser cuffs, straw boater with a rust band.

title: Co-op Foreman
blurb: Field boss: white tee with rolled sleeves, denim overalls with a bib pocket, shoulder straps and buttons, tool belt with two pouches, work boots with thick soles, olive flat cap.

title: Travelling Salesman
blurb: Smooth talker: rust frock coat with a flared skirt, lapels, double gold buttons and flap pockets, mustard turn-back cuffs, sash belt, ledger case, brown bowler hat.
